landing.headline: Every child has a story waiting to be told.
landing.sub: Tell us what they love. We'll turn it into an adventure.
landing.privacyLink: How we protect your child's privacy

child.title: Who is this story for?
child.nameHint: Only if you like. It stays on this device.

interests.title: What do they love?
interests.sub: Write freely, or pick a few doorways into the story.

guidance.title: Would you like the story to gently explore something?
guidance.sub: Stories can help children discover situations, emotions and new ways of thinking.
guidance.customPlaceholder: e.g. My child finds it difficult to approach other children.
guidance.customHint: Used only to shape this one story. It is never saved.
guidance.note: Story guidance gently shapes the adventure. It is not a diagnosis or a therapy, and it doesn't replace professional support.

validation.interests: Add at least one thing they love.

support.title: This sounds like something a story can't carry alone.
support.body: What you described may need the support of a person you trust. You don't have to handle it on your own, and reaching out is a good step.

emergency.label: Emergency
emergency.desc: If someone is in immediate danger.

childHelpline.label: Children and youth helpline
childHelpline.desc: Free and confidential, for children and young people.

doctor.label: Your paediatrician or family doctor
doctor.desc: A good first conversation, and they know where to find more help.

support.verifyNote: Prototype: contact details are for orientation and are being verified with local specialists.
support.continueWithout: Create a story without this text

generating.errorTitle: Our little light lost the story for a moment.

player.silent: There is no storyteller voice for this language on this device yet. The words move along on their own.
player.jumpHint: Tap a sentence to continue from there.
player.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it was saved on another device.
player.unsavedLeave: This story isn’t saved yet. Save it to hear it again later.

library.title: Our stories
library.emptyBody: Stories you save live here, ready to be told again and again.
library.noFavorites: Tap the heart in a story to keep it here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.testPhrase: Once upon a time, a little light floated through the night and found a story.
settings.motionHint: Calm keeps soft fades and the glow of the light, without floating or travelling.

privacy.title: Your child's privacy, simply explained

account.title: No account
account.body: You can use Lumetta without registering or logging in.

minimal.title: Only what a story needs
minimal.body: An age and what your child loves. The first name is optional. We never ask for a surname, birthday, school, address or photos.

local.title: Stories stay on this device
local.body: Saved stories live only in this browser, on this device. Nothing is uploaded to a cloud.

names.title: Names stay home
names.body: When a storytelling service is connected, the first name is replaced by a placeholder before your story wishes leave this device. Your own description is used once and never saved. Only the finished story is sent to the narration voice.

control.title: You decide
control.body: Delete a single story or everything, whenever you like.

privacy.modeDemo: Right now everything is created on this device. No data leaves it.
privacy.modeLive: A storytelling service is connected. Only age, interests, story type and story guidance are shared, without the name.
privacy.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all saved stories from this device?

about.body: Lumetta creates short, illustrated stories that start with what a child loves. It is a prototype, made to be explored together with parents, teachers and specialists.

voices.warmFemaleDesc: Soft and close, like reading on the sofa
voices.warmMaleDesc: Calm and deep, good for bedtime
voices.neutralDesc: Clear and even, lets the story lead

adventure.label: Adventure
adventure.desc: A journey with a brave moment

a11y.companion: The story companion, a small warm light

demo.title: To turn your own idea into a story, Lumetta needs its storytelling service.
demo.body: No storytelling service is connected in this demo. Inventing a new story from any idea takes a language model. A template would only paste your idea in, and we don't want that.
demo.examplesTitle: Listen to an example story instead
demo.examplesNote: These stories were written in advance. They were not created from your idea.
demo.connectHint: The README explains how to connect the storytelling service.
